description:
Migrate the PLE panel base width (resolved once and threaded through the recursion) and the blocked back-substitution threshold.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.6 and the ple row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: panel_base_max_cols is hoisted, resolved once at the panel entry and threaded through ple_in_place_window's recursion by parameter; blocked_back_sub_min_dim is a resolved read; both satisfy design §2.3 with operators unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: ple_panel_route and back_sub_route reporters called by the dispatchers and their route files pass; review confirms the recursion takes the threshold by parameter.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the PLE selectors over to the tuning profile
